import re

# Read the text file
with open('/tmp/paper_pages.txt', 'r') as f:
    text = f.read()

# Estimate pages (roughly 2500-3000 chars per page)
sections = {
    'Experiments': 700,
    'Discussion': 1535,
    'Conclusion': 1637,
    'Limitations': 1660,
    'References': 1811,
    'Appendix': 2478,
}

# Get character positions for more accuracy
lines = text.split('\n')
line_pos = {}
char_count = 0
for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
    if 'Experiments' in line and 'Experiments' not in line_pos:
        line_pos['Experiments'] = (i, char_count)
    if line.startswith('Discussion'):
        line_pos['Discussion'] = (i, char_count)
    if line.startswith('Conclusion'):
        line_pos['Conclusion'] = (i, char_count)
    if line.startswith('Limitations'):
        line_pos['Limitations'] = (i, char_count)
    if line.startswith('References'):
        line_pos['References'] = (i, char_count)
    if line.startswith('Appendix'):
        line_pos['Appendix'] = (i, char_count)
    char_count += len(line) + 1

# Estimate lines per page (ACL format ~50 lines)
lines_per_page = 50

for section, (line_num, char_pos) in sorted(line_pos.items(), key=lambda x: x[1][0]):
    estimated_page = (line_num // lines_per_page) + 1
    print(f"{section}: line {line_num}, estimated page ~{estimated_page}")

print(f"\nTotal lines: {len(lines)}")
print(f"Total pages (at ~50 lines/page): {len(lines) // 50}")
EOF
